mapper.select: SELECT c.contract_id, p.product_name, cust_person.person_name AS customer_name, ins_person.person_name AS insured_name, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.total_premium, c.status FROM insurance_contracts c JOIN insurance_products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id JOIN customers cust ON c.customer_id = cust.customer_id JOIN persons cust_person ON cust.person_id = cust_person.person_id JOIN insureds ins ON c.insured_id = ins.insured_id JOIN persons ins_person ON ins.person_id = ins_person.person_id WHERE c.customer_id = #{customer_id} AND ( (c.start_date IS NULL OR c.start_date >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -36)) OR c.status = 'ACTIVE' ) ORDER BY c.start_date DESC

SELECT c.contract_id, p.product_name, cust_person.person_name AS customer_name, ins_person.person_name AS insured_name, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.total_premium, c.status FROM insurance_contracts c JOIN insurance_products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id JOIN customers cust ON c.customer_id = cust.customer_id JOIN persons cust_person ON cust.person_id = cust_person.person_id JOIN insureds ins ON c.insured_id = ins.insured_id JOIN persons ins_person ON ins.person_id = ins_person.person_id WHERE c.customer_id = #{customer_id} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY c.start_date DESC
